heroHeadline:
Know what the AC will cost
before you call anyone.
heroSub: Tell us what your system is doing, see an honest service-or-replace range in under 60 seconds, then pick your own time slot — no callback request, no waiting to hear back.
resultLabel: Estimated cost range · Final price confirmed on site before any work starts
howHeadline: A real number and a real time slot, before anyone waits on a callback.

steps.title: Tell us what it's doing
steps.desc: Blowing warm, tripping the breaker, running all day, or a system that's simply old enough to replace — pick it, add your home size, and say how soon you need someone. Under a minute, no sign-up, works on any phone.

steps.title: See service vs replace
steps.desc: An honest range built on Highland's own pricing — a service call when a service call is the right answer, a new Carrier system when the old one has genuinely run its course. Not a teaser number to get a truck in the driveway.

steps.title: Pick your service window
steps.desc: Choose a slot from the real schedule and it's confirmed on the spot. A licensed tech comes out, confirms the diagnosis, and gives you the final price before any work starts.

galleryHeadline: Recent AC replacements and service calls.
bookingSub: Real availability straight from the schedule — choose a time and it's confirmed. No callback request, no wondering whether the message got through.
